item.title: Texas Democratic hopeful vows 'internment camp for American Zionists,' castration center
item.description:

The San Antonio candidate, running in the May 26 primary runoff for Texas' 35th District, also accused her opponent of treason and promoted antisemitic conspiracy theories. Mainstream Democrats, including Senate nominee James Talarico, have publicly refused to campaign alongside her.
